## File for $0 With TurboTax Free Edition

As mentioned above, users can file for free with [TurboTax Free Edition](https://cna.st/affiliate-). Around 37% of taxpayers qualify. This service is for simple Form 1040 returns only (no schedules except for the Earned Income Tax Credit, Child Tax Credit, Student Loan Interest, and Schedule 1-A). While this may not be the right fit for every type of tax filer, it works for those with simple finances. Do a little research to see if TurboTax Free Edition may be right for you to save big instead of spending big. [TurboTax Free Edition](https://cna.st/affiliate-) includes $0 to file for Federal taxes and $0 for State taxes. ## Summary

**TLDR:** TurboTax’s 10 percent coupon softens the price, but an affiliate-driven deal page should not substitute for comparing service tiers, eligibility, and total filing cost.

- The article advertises an extra 10 percent off federal online tax filings through TurboTax coupons, although the excerpt does not provide the offer’s complete terms.
- TurboTax offers free self-filing to qualifying users, expert assistance through Live Assisted, and Full Service preparation and review by a tax professional.
- The linked promotion is aimed at US customers; the article directs Canadian users to a separate offer.
- A percentage discount alone does not identify the best option because the appropriate tier and final price depend on a filer’s eligibility and required level of professional help.

## 摘要

**重點摘要：** TurboTax 九折看似省錢，但聯盟導購文章無法替你判斷方案資格、服務差異與報稅總成本是否真的划算。

- 文章主打 TurboTax 美國聯邦線上報稅服務額外九折，但節錄內容沒有列出完整優惠條款。
- 服務分成符合資格者可用的免費自行申報、可隨時詢問稅務專家的 Live Assisted，以及由專家代為準備並共同確認的 Full Service。
- 頁面中的折扣以美國客戶為主，加拿大使用者必須改用另一組優惠。
- 折扣幅度無法單獨證明哪個方案最便宜；使用者資格、稅務複雜度及是否需要專家協助，都會改變最後成本。
